name: Steven Gay
career_history: EMEA Region Lead - Land Acquisition at Microsoft, 2/2026 to present; Sub-Regional Land Acquisition Lead - North Europe at Microsoft, 10/2024 to present; Senior Land Acquisition Manager at Microsoft, 6/2022 to present; Partner at Ryden, 5/2007 to 5/2022; Associate at Ryden, 1/2002 to 5/2007; Associate at Gooch Webster, 9/1996 to 2/2002; Surveyor at James Barr, 9/1993 to 8/1996

career.title: Sub-Regional Land Acquisition Lead - North Europe

education: BSc Hons Estate Management, Heriot-Watt University
biography:
In my current role at Microsoft I am responsible for the identification and acquisition of property assets.

As part of Microsoft Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) I have a key role in the delivery of assets for date centre development which allow Microsoft’s Cloud business to continues to grow and mature, a broad range of skills and knowledge are required to deliver on this challenging role which focuses on our EMEA business. 

Key responsibilities include identifying and acquiring assets, managing transaction data and deal flow,  ensuring that all relevant data and associated documents are tracked and kept updated. Participate and lead cross team strategies for land banking and site acquisitions, driving alignment across Land Development, Fibre, Power, and Construction functions to capitalize on data center development opportunities.
Assist in the management and implementation of metrics to plan, manage, measure and evaluate  transaction performance and strategy.  Strong communication skills are required given the critical nature of the role - and working with key stakeholders and business partners – both internally and externally to ensure success.

Close collaboration to ensure aspects such as operations, zoning /permitting, legal, finance, treasury, tax and risk are all assessed correctly to help deliver highly successful projects for the business.

Prior to this I was a Partner at Ryden LLP specialising in Investment agency, Development and Finance.  I have have extensive experience in other areas, including advice on asset management strategies for clients as well as experience of Enterprise zones and BPRA projects. Direct Office & Industrial agency experience gained prior to specialisation in the Investment Sector.

Broad coverage in both the UK markets has been gained through various projects and latterly significant experience across European Markets.

With over 30 years experience in the property market, covering all aspects of Capital Markets and property  development across each of the main property sectors and Tech sector.
